title: DvEB: Distributed van Emde Boas Tree
description:
Research prototype of a distributed van Emde Boas (vEB) tree, written in C++14 with arbitrary-precision keys (GMP). The universe of the tree grows on demand, from 2^(2^k) to 2^(2^(k+1)); every node is named by an identifier derived from its position in the tree, which stays valid as the tree grows; and nodes are spread over machines and located by IP multicast, using a lightweight request-acknowledge-reply-acknowledge protocol over UDP.

This is the code used in the experiments of the master's dissertation Distributed van Emde Boas Tree (Federal Rural University of Pernambuco, 2017), which describes the design, the software architecture and the exact experimental configuration.
